events.verdict: Knueppel (CHA) avoids making illegal contact with Kuzma's (MIL) arm during the dunk.
Rollins (MIL) steps forward into Ball's (CHA) path, initiating contact that affects his FOM.
Knueppel (CHA) engages with Green (MIL), but does not affect his FOM.
Green (MIL) grazes Ball's (CHA) arm during the pass.
Diabate (CHA) is in a legal position in Kuzma's (MIL) path before deflecting the ball away.
Diabate (CHA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Diabate (CHA) wraps his arm around Antetokounmpo (MIL), allowing Diabate to get to the pass and deflect it.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) steps forward into Ball's (CHA) path, initiating illegal foot contact.
Knueppel (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Kuzma (MIL) in the post.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) jumps vertically with an arm extended, which he collapses as he braces for the ensuing marginal contact with Bridges (CHA) during the dunk attempt.
Bridges (CHA) commits a take foul on Antetokounmpo (MIL).
Bridges (CHA) directly contests Antetokounmpo's (MIL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Antetokounmpo's hand after the release.
